name: Alfried Girdis
original_name: アルフリート・ガーディス
source:
Around 25 years old, half-elf.
Star Sign: Aquarius
Occupation: Rune Knight

The only grown adult in a party full of women and children.
He's like a nursemaid... eh more or less the leader.
He seems cool and collected at first, but he's the one who worries the most in the group.
He isn't good with strangers so at first he seems cold, but he's just shy.
A bit of a loser.
